visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a man with wavy shoulder-length hair holding two red ice cream cups in a brightly lit retail shop. The camera quickly cuts to extreme close-ups of the ice cream, showcasing chocolate drizzle, Oreo pieces, and cocoa powder. (2) Detailed shots focus on a red spoon digging into a cream-colored scoop topped with sponge cake and a small liquid pipette. The man is then shown in eye-level medium shots tasting the product, his facial expressions displaying high delight and exaggerated reactions. (3) Transitioning to a new phase, the man is seen wearing a black apron standing in front of an ice cream counter. A female staff member wearing a black uniform and mask prepares to throw a scoop of ice cream. (4) The camera captures a wide shot of the staff member launching a green scoop across the room. The man catches it perfectly in his red cup, subsequently celebrating with raised arms and a joyous expression. (5) The final phase shows the man holding the caught green ice cream, talking enthusiastically to the camera while text overlays promote an anniversary event.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy electronic pop track featuring a driving 4/4 synthetic beat. A male narrator introduces the content with an enthusiastic, high-arousal tone and rapid speech rate. (2) As the narrator describes the tiramisu flavors, the BGM continues as a steady, bright background layer. Clear transients of a spoon clinking against a cup are audible. (3) A distinct acoustic shift occurs with a female voice performing a rhythmic countdown: '3, 2, 1.' A sharp percussive thud follows as a scoop is caught, immediately accompanied by a swell of laughter and applause. (4) The final phase features the narrator’s concluding remarks in an animated, comic delivery style. The BGM remains energetic until a quick fade-out at the video's end.
